selector-disallowed-list.message: Phase 6a F28 layer-2: jobs-pane.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .jobs-bucket / .job-card / #jobs-pane / #jobs-buckets-container / .jobs-pane-* to prevent cross-pane CSS leak that would drift the Phase 5 visual baseline.

Phase 6b F28 layer-2: action-required.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .action-required-widget / #action-required-section to prevent cross-pane CSS leak that would drift the multiplexer visual baseline.
Phase 6b F28 layer-2: tts-chrome.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .tts-chrome / #tts-pane to prevent cross-pane CSS leak that would drift the multiplexer visual baseline.
